description: Op-shaped job that walks the live Dagster asset graph and pushes lineage to Precisely Data360 Govern via the Catalog REST endpoint (OAuth2 client-credentials auth).

tags.label: Job Tags
tags.description: Dagster job tags as key-value pairs.

catalog_url.label: Data360 Catalog URL
catalog_url.description: Data360 Govern Catalog REST base URL.

token_url.label: OAuth2 Token URL
token_url.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (override for non-global Data360 tenants).

client_id_env.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env.description: Env var with the Data360 OAuth2 client_id.

client_secret_env.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env.description: Env var with the Data360 OAuth2 client_secret.

only_export_on_change.label: Only Export on Change
only_export_on_change.description: Hash the structural payload and skip push when unchanged from the previous successful run.

fail_on_catalog_error.label: Fail on Catalog Error
fail_on_catalog_error.description: If true, fail the run when the catalog is unreachable or PUTs error. Default true.
